#!/bin/sh
set -eu
# Kathara: interfacce gia attive, solo IPv4 e routing statico.
ip -4 address show dev eth0 | grep -Fq 'inet 10.14.1.11/24 ' || ip address add 10.14.1.11/24 dev eth0

ip route replace default via 10.14.1.1 dev eth0

# ARP statico limitato ai vicini sul medesimo dominio L2.
ip -4 neigh replace 10.14.1.1 lladdr 02:00:00:0a:01:01 nud permanent dev eth0
ip -4 neigh replace 10.14.1.12 lladdr 02:00:00:0a:01:03 nud permanent dev eth0
ip -4 neigh replace 10.14.1.13 lladdr 02:00:00:0a:01:04 nud permanent dev eth0
ip -4 neigh replace 10.14.1.14 lladdr 02:00:00:0a:01:05 nud permanent dev eth0

# Stabilizzazione del gateway (massimo 8 tentativi, mai fatale).
probe_attempt=0
while [ "$probe_attempt" -lt 8 ]; do
    if ping -n -I eth0 -c 1 -W 1 10.14.1.1 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        break
    fi
    probe_attempt=$((probe_attempt + 1))
    [ "$probe_attempt" -lt 8 ] || break
    sleep 1
done

/usr/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
zones=['.','com','net','example.com','service.com','lab.net','tools.net','shop.example.com','api.service.com','research.lab.net','ci.tools.net','ai.research.lab.net','data.research.lab.net']
ips=[]
for i in range(1,15):
 s=Path(f'pc{i}.startup').read_text(); ips.append(re.search(r\"inet (\\d+\\.\\d+\\.\\d+\\.\\d+)/\",s).group(1))
parents={1:0,2:0,3:1,4:1,5:2,6:2,7:3,8:4,9:5,10:6,11:9,12:9}
names=['a.root-servers.']+['ns.'+z+'.' for z in zones[1:]]
for i,z in enumerate(zones):
 d=Path(f'pc{i+1}/etc/bind'); d.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 filename='db.root' if i==0 else 'db.'+z
 conf=f'options {{ directory \"/var/cache/bind\"; recursion no; allow-query {{ any; }}; dnssec-validation no; listen-on {{ any; }}; listen-on-v6 {{ none; }}; }};\\nzone \"{z}\" {{ type master; file \"/etc/bind/{filename}\"; }};\\n'
 (d/'named.conf').write_text(conf)
 hostmaster='hostmaster.' if i==0 else 'hostmaster.'+z+'.'
 lines=['"'$TTL 3600'"',f'@ IN SOA {names[i]} {hostmaster} ( 1 3600 900 604800 300 )',f'@ IN NS {names[i]}',f'{names[i]} IN A {ips[i]}']
 for child,parent in parents.items():
  if parent==i:
   lines += [f'{zones[child]}. IN NS {names[child]}', f'{names[child]} IN A {ips[child]}']
 if i in (7,8,10,11,12): lines.append(f'@ IN A {ips[i]}')
 if i in (3,4,5,6):
  lines += [f'@ IN MX 10 mail.{z}.',f'mail IN A {ips[i]}']
 if i==3: lines.append(f'www IN A {ips[i]}')
 (d/filename).write_text('\\n'.join(lines)+'\\n')
 Path(f'pc{i+1}.startup').open('a').write('\\n# DNS\\nsystemctl restart named\\n')
d=Path('pc14/etc/bind'); d.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
(d/'named.conf').write_text('options { directory \"/var/cache/bind\"; recursion yes; allow-recursion { any; }; allow-query { any; }; dnssec-validation no; listen-on { any; }; listen-on-v6 { none; }; };\\nzone \".\" { type hint; file \"/etc/bind/db.hints\"; };\\n')
(d/'db.hints').write_text(f'. 3600000 IN NS {names[0]}\\n{names[0]} 3600000 IN A {ips[0]}\\n')
Path('pc14.startup').open('a').write('\\n# DNS\\nsystemctl restart named\\n')
for i in range(16,21): Path(f'pc{i}.startup').open('a').write(f'\\n# DNS\\necho \"nameserver {ips[13]}\" > /etc/resolv.conf\\n')
p=Path('lab.conf'); s=p.read_text()
for i in range(1,15): s=s.replace(f'pc{i}[image]=\"kathara/base\"',f'pc{i}[image]=\"kathara/bind\"')
p.write_text(s)
PY
command -v named-checkzone; command -v named-checkconf"

Updated [lab.conf](/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-cfdhtnql/lab/lab.conf), the assigned devices’ startup files, and their BIND configuration files. The images for pc1–pc14 were changed to `kathara/bind`; existing topology, addresses, and routes were preserved.

Assumed `www.example.com` uses pc4’s existing address. Static checks passed for the zone and delegation structure; BIND validation tools were unavailable locally, and runtime resolution was not tested.
